page.overview:
Who is Bioluminescent Velociraptor?

The bioluminescent Velociraptor is a bioluminescent hybrid of Velociraptor and cuttlefish that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

The bioluminescent Velociraptor is a variant for the Velociraptor that can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Velociraptor DNA; 2 samples of any Medium DNA; and 1 sample of Cuttlefish DNA.
